items.text:
As it is, this is 20 times more complicated than neoscavenger, but with none of the fun.  Either the tutorial was bugged to be impossible to complete, or even accessing items that in a storage compartment is so complex as to be unplayable.

Having played and loved neoscavenger, I was looking forward to this game, but... this is a mess.  I thought the UI situation for neoscavenger was bad, but this is an order of magnitude worse
items.text_zh:
就目前而言，这比neoscavenger复杂20倍，但完全没有乐趣。要么是教程有bug导致无法完成，要么就是连访问储物格里的物品都复杂到无法游玩。

玩过并热爱neoscavenger之后，我一直期待这款游戏，但是……这是一团糟。我以为neoscavenger的UI状况很糟糕，但这个要糟糕一个数量级
